ESP32-2432S028R Boombox Project

This is an interactive web demonstration of the xtouch ESP32-2432S028R boombox project.

Features Demonstrated:

  • ESP32-2432S028R hardware simulation
  • 2.8" ILI9341 TFT display with touch interface
  • Real-time audio processing and equalizer
  • LVGL user interface
  • I2S audio output simulation
  • Performance monitoring

Technologies Used:

  • Three.js for 3D hardware visualization
  • Web Audio API for audio processing
  • Canvas for UI rendering and visualization
  • WebGL for hardware acceleration

Instructions:

  1. Click on the simulated display to interact with the UI
  2. Upload your own audio files or use the demo track
  3. Adjust the equalizer settings and hear the changes
  4. Monitor performance metrics in real-time
  5. Try different simulation modes and hardware scenarios
